signals.entity: Embassy of Italy in Tehran / VisaMetric
signals.summary: Iranian students were reported to face continuing difficulty obtaining Italian student-visa appointments in Tehran. A Turin court order concerning appointment access was reported, followed later by a limited VisaMetric appointment-registration opening for 24 November 2025.

evidence.claim: Problems with student-visa appointment access for Iranian students were reported as continuing despite a Turin court order.
A VisaMetric registration window for Italian student-visa requests was announced for 24 November 2025.

signals.summary: A significant delay in the first scholarship installment for students in Turin was reported. A later channel update stated that EDISU had announced payment of the first installment for the following week.

evidence.claim: An unprecedented delay in the initial scholarship installment for many students in Turin was reported.
The channel reported that EDISU had announced first-installment payment during the following week.

signals.summary: The channel reported scholarship limitations or budget pressure affecting several locations, including Pavia and universities in Veneto, while explicitly warning that conditions can change by academic year.

evidence.claim: The post described scholarship funding constraints across several regions and explicitly stated that the situation may change from year to year.

signals.summary: The channel reported that the Duolingo English Test was unavailable in Iran and for users authenticating with Iranian identification documents. This is not Italy-specific but may affect Iranian applicants whose intended Italian program accepts DET.

evidence.claim: The post stated that DET access had been stopped in Iran and for users with Iranian IDs.
